embeds.title: Welcome to SAUVAGE™
embeds.description:
Los Santos' premier brand & visual identity studio. Logos, menus, signage, social kits and full business identities for GTA World enterprises, paid in in-game dollars via Fleeca.

**Start here:**
1. Read #rules
2. Say hi in #introductions
3. Order in #how-to-order

fields.name: 🛠️ Need a design?
fields.value: Browse #pricing or tell us your brief in #open-a-ticket.

fields.name: 💬 Talk to the team
fields.value: Ping @Client Relations to open a new order or ask a question.

fields.name: 🔒 Verified clients
fields.value: Get the **Verified Client** role after your first deposit to unlock the CLIENT AREA.

fields.name: 🌐 Orders & payments
fields.value: Deposits and balances are moved through the **Fleeca gateway** on sauvagecreative.ls — no real currency, ever.

embeds.title: 📜 Studio Rules
embeds.description: Keep this server clean. Breaking a rule can get you warned or removed.

fields.name: 1 — Stay in character
fields.value: All business and community channels are in-character and set in Los Santos.

fields.name: 2 — No spam or scams
fields.value: No advertisements, referral spam, or competing service promotion.

fields.name: 3 — Respect people
fields.value: Harassment, hate speech, or drama gets you removed fast.

fields.name: 4 — In-game currency only
fields.value: All work is paid in GTA World dollars via Fleeca. We never ask for real money.

fields.name: 5 — Vouches need proof
fields.value: Testimonials require a verified completed order reference.

fields.name: 6 — Follow staff
fields.value: Staff instructions in tickets and channels are final.

embeds.title: 🎨 How to Order a Design
embeds.description: From idea to download in six steps:

fields.name: 1 — Pick a package
fields.value: Choose **Logo**, **Complete Brand Kit**, or **Menus & Collateral** in #pricing.

fields.name: 2 — Tell us your brief
fields.value: Open a ticket in #open-a-ticket with your business name, concept, and deliverables.

fields.name: 3 — Send your references
fields.value: Attach logos, colour palettes, or examples you want us to match.

fields.name: 4 — Pay 50% deposit
fields.value: Instant payment through the **Fleeca gateway** confirms your slot and opens your project.

fields.name: 5 — Track your project
fields.value: Get progress in #design-updates and review deliveries in the CLIENT AREA.

fields.name: 6 — Accept & download
fields.value: Happy with the result? Accept, pay the balance, download your files, and leave a vouch.

footer.text: Custom briefs are quoted within 12 hours.

embeds.title: 🎟 Start Your Order
embeds.description: Reply here to open an order. Include:

fields.name: Business name
fields.value: The enterprise the design is for.

fields.name: Package / brief
fields.value: Which package from #pricing, or a custom description.

fields.name: Your Discord tag
fields.value: The tag you used on the website (sauvagecreative.ls).

footer.text: A member of @Client Relations will pick up your ticket.

embeds.title: 💰 Current Packages
embeds.description: All prices are **GTA World in-game dollars** ($), paid in two instalments via Fleeca — 50% to start, 50% on acceptance.

fields.name: Logo & Visual Emblem — $15,000
fields.value: Primary logo + transparent PNGs, monochrome badges, SVG master, 2 revisions. ~24-48h

fields.name: Complete Brand Kit — $35,000
fields.value: Logo suite, letterhead & invoice, business cards, Facebrowser banners, forum thread code, 3 revisions. ~2-4 days

fields.name: Menus, Cards & Collateral — $20,000
fields.value: Menus, VIP cards, flyers, in-game textures, hosted image links. ~24-48h

fields.name: Custom briefs
fields.value: Hidden items, faction heraldry, billboards, fleet wraps and more — quoted within 12 hours.

footer.text: Full details on the website: sauvagecreative.ls

fields.name: How do I pay?
fields.value: Via the Fleeca Bank gateway using your character's routing number. 50% deposit, 50% on acceptance.

fields.name: What files do I get?
fields.value: Transparent PNGs, SVG vectors, optimised JPGs and BBCode for the GTA World forum.

fields.name: How fast?
fields.value: Logos/menus 24-48h; full brand kits 2-4 days. Rush (<24h) available.

fields.name: What if I want changes?
fields.value: Every package includes 2-3 revision rounds. Ask in your project room.

embeds.title: ⭐ Leave a Vouch
embeds.description: Worked with us? Drop your testimonial here.

fields.name: How it works
fields.value:
1. Post your review with your order reference (e.g. REQ-XXXX).
2. @Client Relations verifies it.
3. It's approved and displayed on the site.

footer.text: Only verified completed orders are published.
